peer_isolation: separate OS address spaces; same user and host; not a sandbox
attacker_scope: Two fixed, untrained timestamp heuristics see only client-edge full-write times and provider receive/release times. Synthetic ground truth is joined only for scoring.
measurement_limits: Not an anonymity proof or a comprehensive active/global adversary evaluation.
Single host shares CPU and a wall clock; network geography, independent operators and link authentication are absent.
TCP stream byte counters include HTTP, not TCP/IP headers, retransmissions or physical wire bytes.
No raw observations, job labels, packet payloads or cryptographic material are persisted.
A missing reply stops that client's sequential workload; there are no automatic retries. Planned, submitted and completed jobs are distinct.
Each scenario changes one factor. The direct control uses the same fixed Sphinx cell geometry but a one-hop request/reply path without cover or mix delays.

reference.reason: The stock Docker generator and server write identity.private.pem and link.private.pem. The user's rule keeps credentials out of files. No keys or testnet were generated; no reference measurements are fabricated.
